privacy.dataUsageBody: Your scan photos are stored privately and used only to identify your specimen and improve accuracy. Location is coarse and fuzzed. Subscriptions are handled only on the website — the app never processes payments.

coverage.title: EVIDENCE BASIS
coverage.thin: This score rests on {{present}} of {{total}} layers. What is missing was not looked for — it is not evidence of absence.

notScoredWhy.drainage: The channel network is real and country-wide, but measurement shows it carries no general signal — known occurrences sit with respect to drainage exactly as random ground does. It waits for a commodity profile (placer), rather than being given a weight the data does not support.
notScoredWhy.contacts: The Abbate 1:1,500,000 contacts are real geology, and 1,538 of them are loaded. They are still not scored: known occurrences sit within 10 km of a contact 91% of the time against 26% of random ground, but stratified by rock type that gap almost vanishes — 1.17x inside metamorphic ground. The map is subdivided most finely where the basement is, and the basement is where the finds are, so scoring contacts would count the geology signal a second time.

commodity.title: COMMODITY
commodity.universalNote: Assessing the ground on its geology alone, with no commodity assumed. This is the validated default: it ranks known mineralised ground above random ground with an AUC of 0.90, and 0.84 with all knowledge of past finds removed.
commodity.none: This pack contains no commodity profiles.
commodity.occurrences: {{count}} mapped occurrence(s) of this commodity in the pack
commodity.notAProbability: Prospectivity Score ranks this ground against other ground. It is not a probability of finding anything, and no odds of discovery can be given from this data.

addWaypoint.title: ADD WAYPOINT
addWaypoint.gpsAutomatic: Your position, accuracy, altitude and heading are recorded automatically from the live GPS fix. There is nothing to type — a position entered by hand is one nobody can check.
addWaypoint.sampleIdHint: Generated for you, and editable — make it match the label on the bag.
addWaypoint.sampleDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. White quartz vein with iron staining
addWaypoint.observationPlaceholder: e.g. Quartz vein visible, green mineral crystals, sulphide staining
addWaypoint.observationHint: Recorded as YOUR OBSERVATION. The assessment treats it as something to be checked, never as an established fact.
addWaypoint.photoHint: Saved on this device at once and queued for upload. They will send by themselves when a network appears — nothing is lost offline.
addWaypoint.reportedOk: Recorded at {{lat}}, {{lng}} — as reported, not observed here.
addWaypoint.reportedNeedsCoords: Enter the latitude and longitude you were sent.

nearby.contextOnly: Your own earlier work, shown for context. It does not change the prospectivity score.

score.universal: Assessed on geology alone, with no commodity assumed.

missing.none: Nothing further was identified as missing.

action.none: No further work is recommended from this evidence.

action.panning_test: Pan the drainage for heavy minerals
action.examine_alteration: Examine and record alteration around the vein
action.revisit_with_gps: Revisit with a better GPS fix
action.petrographic_analysis: Submit a sample for petrographic analysis
action.check_fault_zone: Inspect the fault zone for shearing and quartz

significance.hydrothermal_indicator: may occur in hydrothermal systems, but needs geochemical confirmation
significance.fluid_pathway: faults can act as pathways for mineralising fluids
significance.favourable_host: this rock type hosts this commodity elsewhere
significance.structural_control: many deposits of this style are structurally controlled
significance.weathering_product: may be a weathering product rather than primary mineralisation
significance.oxidation_indicator: indicates oxidation, which can overlie sulphides
significance.not_available: this was never measured, which is different from being measured and found absent
significance.none_in_range: the layer is loaded but none of it is near this site
significance.context_only: context rather than an indicator on its own
significance.requires_assay: cannot be assessed without laboratory work

observations.none: Nothing was recorded on the ground for this section.

visual.none: No photographs were read for this section.

context.none: The engine had no mapped reading for this ground.

report.failedNote: The evidence is safe on this device and on the server. Only the reading failed — it can be asked for again.

fieldWork.title: Enterprise Field Work

start.title: Start Exploration
start.body: Take a target, walk to it, record what is there. Works with no signal.

reports.title: Exploration Reports
reports.body: Sections you have finished, and the AI geologist's reading of each.

samples.title: My Samples
samples.body: Specimens you collected. Identified from the rock itself — no location assessment.

fieldWork.footnote: A sample is identified from the specimen. A report interprets the ground. The two are kept apart on purpose.

guide.title: HOW THIS WORKS

s1.title: Start Exploration
s1.body: The engine reads the ground under you and offers a target. Walk to it — the map keeps guiding with no signal.

s2.title: Record what is there
s2.body: At the target, add a waypoint. Use FIELD CAMERA for the photographs — it has the zoom and the focus lock a hand specimen needs.

s3.title: Finish Section
s3.body: Everything is written to this phone first. Nothing needs a network, and nothing is lost if there is none.

s4.title: Read the report
s4.body: When a signal appears, the evidence uploads and the AI geologist reads it. The report waits for you under Exploration Reports.

guide.offline: My Samples is a separate thing: a rock you picked up, identified from the specimen itself. It never assesses the ground it came from.
